57/S0.subgoal: Describe the stages of the 3D graphics pipeline and introduce the viewing pipeline.

57/S1.subgoal: Explain the concept of the viewing pipeline using a photography analogy.

57/S2.subgoal: Describe the sub-stages and operations that constitute the viewing pipeline.

57/S3.subgoal: Explain the 3D viewing transformation and the camera parameters used to define the view coordinate system.

57/S4.subgoal: Describe the projection transformation, including perspective and parallel projections and the canonical view volume.

57/S6.subgoal: Describe the operations of clipping and hidden surface removal.

57/S7.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts of the viewing pipeline.
